name: V-Cut
idea: Walk your defender in toward the basket, then sprint back out to get open.
why: Your defender has to follow you in. When you suddenly turn and run back out, they are a step too slow to keep up.
tryit: Walk in slowly, then plant your foot and push off hard. Show your hands so the passer knows you are ready.

frames.say: {1} has the ball, but {X2} and {X3} are guarding super close. Nobody is open yet!
*V-cut:* {2} walks in toward the basket, nice and slow. {X2} follows.
Then {2} pushes off and sprints back out. {X2} gets left behind!
{1} passes to {2}. In, then out: the path {2} ran makes a *V*!
Swish! Walk in slow, then cut out fast. That’s a V-cut.
